# Ernoxin Gold

> Persian-language live gold and coin price dashboard with educational articles for the Iranian market.

Ernoxin Gold (gold.ernoxin.com) shows live gold and coin prices sourced from the official Tehran Gold Union (estjt.ir), interactive charts, historical trends, and a Persian blog about buying gold safely.

## Primary URLs

- Live prices (main page): https://gold.ernoxin.com/price/
- Price trends: https://gold.ernoxin.com/price/trends/{days} (7, 30, 90, 180, 365)
- Keyword hubs (high-intent landing pages):
  - Mozaneh (مظنه): https://gold.ernoxin.com/price/mozaneh
  - Coin bubble (حباب سکه): https://gold.ernoxin.com/price/coin-bubble
  - Global ounce (انس جهانی): https://gold.ernoxin.com/price/ounce
- Blog index: https://gold.ernoxin.com/blog
- RSS feed: https://gold.ernoxin.com/blog/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://gold.ernoxin.com/sitemap.xml

## Target Keywords (Persian)

| Intent | Hub page | Deep article |
|--------|----------|--------------|
| قیمت مظنه امروز | /price/mozaneh | /blog/gold-mozaneh |
| حباب سکه امروز | /price/coin-bubble | /blog/coin-bubble-today-checklist |
| قیمت انس جهانی | /price/ounce | /blog/global-ounce-impact-iran-gold |
| قیمت طلا امروز | /price/ | /blog/gold-price-guide |
| قیمت سکه امروز | /price/ | /blog/gold-coin-guide |

## What This Site Is Best For

- قیمت طلا امروز (today's gold price in Iran)
- قیمت سکه امروز (today's coin price)
- قیمت طلای ۱۸ عیار (18-karat gold price)
- نمودار قیمت طلا (gold price chart)
- حباب سکه، اجرت طلا، فاکتور طلا، خرید امن طلا (educational articles)

## Data Source

Prices are fetched from the official Tehran Gold & Jewelry Union website (estjt.ir) and refreshed periodically. Prices shown are informational; shop prices may differ due to making charge, profit margin, and taxes.

## Content Structure

- Keyword hub pages: `/price/mozaneh`, `/price/coin-bubble`, `/price/ounce` — live prices + FAQ + article links
- Article pages: `/blog/{slug}` — Persian educational content, not financial advice
- Price dashboard: `/price/` — live market data with SSR for crawlers
- Search: `/blog?q=` — internal search (noindex)
- API (read-only): `/api/market/summary` — JSON market summary

## Do Not Crawl

- `/api/market/fetch` — write-only manual fetch endpoint

## Language

All public content is in Persian (fa-IR), RTL layout.
